health.requirementText: The wheelchair must fold to fit in the boot. The passenger must be able to transfer to the car seat, alone or with light assistance.

health.disclaimer: Non-medical transport service, not covered by French national health insurance. For reimbursed medical transport, please contact an ambulance, VSL or approved taxi.

commitment.title: Never left without a ride
commitment.text: If I'm not available on the date or at the time you need, I commit to finding you another trusted partner driver who meets the same quality standards. No searching on your side: I take care of everything.

items.a: Use the booking form, call me or message me on WhatsApp. I'll quickly confirm the ride and the price.
I'll find you a trusted partner driver who meets the same standards. You keep me as your contact from start to finish.

items.q: Do you offer château and wine cellar tours?
items.a: Yes: half day, full day or tailor-made. I wait during every visit and drive you home safely after tastings.

items.q: Do you assist people with reduced mobility?
items.a: Yes, provided the wheelchair is foldable and the passenger can transfer to the seat. This service is non-medical and not covered by French health insurance.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Card, cash and bank transfer. Invoicing is available for businesses.
